items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: Well, Wolcott is the one I'm talking about. Wolcott had one.

ctx.x: You didn't know those people? Well, no. Well, I remember the rabbit foot show had two of them. Yeah.
Well, Wolcott is the one I'm talking about. Wolcott had one. I don't know if he had two, but I know he had one.
Well, there's nothing there, too. You called Snowball or something like that.
